messages:
alex: Quick sync — planning to apply a small Terraform change that wires ExternalSecrets for staging+prod and adds a Secret Manager IAM binding. Before I land, quick Qs: do we require the full prod release gate for this? Also the overlay patch lives at `infra/overlays/staging/secrets-patch.yaml`. Anyone see obvious blockers?

maria: Can you drop the PR link and the exact terraform snippet?

alex: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/542 — main bits: adding `google_secret_manager_secret_iam_member` for the k8s SA and creating `KubernetesExternalSecret` CRs in the overlays. Snippet: 
```
resource "google_secret_manager_secret_iam_member" "se" {
  secret = google_secret_manager_secret.myapp.name
  role   = "roles/secretmanager.secretAccessor"
  member = "serviceAccount:${var.k8s_sa}"
}
```
Overlay patch uses: 
```
apiVersion: external-secrets.io/v1beta1
kind: ExternalSecret
metadata:
  name: myapp-db
spec:
  secretStoreRef:
    name: gcp-sm
    kind: SecretStore
  target:
    name: myapp-db
  data:
    - secretKey: DB_PASSWORD
      remoteRef:
        key: projects/my-project/secrets/myapp-db
```

sam: Wait — are we standardizing on ExternalSecrets or sealed-secrets? Mixing both in the same repo caused confusion last quarter.

alex: We're using ExternalSecrets here. Sealed-Secrets is legacy for some charts; this change only touches `overlays/*/external-secrets`.

jin: For gating: infra policy says any PR that modifies `overlays/prod/**` must trigger `infra-ci` and requires an `infra-prod` approver. We also run `kustomize build` + `kubeval` + smoke tests automatically. If it only touches staging overlays, it can go with a normal review.

maria: Approver list current? Do we need to add @jin to the approvers for prod?

alex: I added @jin in the PR description and applied the `infra-prod` label. Thinking to treat this as low-risk: RBAC + secret access only. Could we do a canary apply to prod instead of full gate?

sam: RBAC changes are not low-risk in prod. Suggest: apply to staging, run smoke tests, then a rolling canary in prod (one AZ), validate auth flows, then complete.

deploy-bot: infra-ci started run #7789 — kustomize build (staging) in progress...

deploy-bot: infra-ci run #7789 — kustomize build ✅, kubeval ✅, integration smoke tests failing: `auth-check` failed (secret key missing)

alex: I saw the failing smoke test: `Failed to map secretKeyRef: key not found 'db_password'` — looks like key name mismatch between secret and overlay.

maria: In staging overlay we reference `dbPassword` (camelCase) but secret exposes `DB_PASSWORD`. Change overlay to `DB_PASSWORD` key. Also confirm the remoteRef path.

jin: Also double-check the service account has `roles/secretmanager.secretAccessor` on the right secret path. I can run `gcloud secrets get-iam-policy` quickly if needed.

alex: Pushed fix to PR (updated key to `DB_PASSWORD`, added RoleBinding change). Requesting review from @maria and @sam.

maria: LGTM for staging. Re-run CI and tag me when green.

deploy-bot: infra-ci run #7791 started — staging kustomize ✅, kubeval ✅, smoke tests ✅ — staging canary metrics look healthy. Rolling canary to prod queued by @alex.

sam: One more: external-secrets operator needs a RoleBinding that includes `kube-system` watch permission in case secrets are referenced cross-namespace. Please add that exception.

alex: Added RoleBinding change in the PR. Waiting 1 hour to monitor staging metrics then will promote.

jin: For prod approval I'll need the `kustomize build` artifact and the smoke-test logs pasted in the PR comment. Also schedule deploy in the 02:00-04:00 UTC maintenance window.

alex: Pasting build snippet: 
```
# kustomize build infra/overlays/prod
apiVersion: v1
kind: Secret
metadata:
  name: myapp-db
  annotations:
    external-secrets.io/managed: "true"
```

alex: Smoke tests on the staging canary: `auth-check` ✅, basic e2e ✅, p50 latency within baseline. Requesting prod approval @jin.

jin: Approved. Create a release tag, run the prod apply during the maintenance window, and ping on-call if anything spikes.

alex: Will schedule the deploy for 02:30 UTC and tag you. Thanks all :rocket:
